body.label: Effect
body.html: Spend 1 additional Mana. Choose one creature within 5 units; remove one normal Condition from it. If you spend the additional Mana, you may also make that creature Possessed.

surges.html: If this Rite triggers because of an ally, that ally becomes Rallied.
When this Rite's Echo resolves, it may also remove one normal Condition from an affected creature.

rider.title: OFFERING RITE
rider.html: After resolving this Action, you may establish this Rite. Trigger: You spend Stamina, Focus, or Mana while within 5 units of the Rite. Echo: One ally within 5 units gains +1 Defense until its next turn.
